primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Change from Baseline to Day 43 in the Neuropsychiatric Inventory-Nursing Home Version (NPI-NH) psychosis score (Delusions \[Domain A\]+Hallucinations \[Domain B\]) in the Full Analysis Set (FAS). The NPI-NH is a questionnaire that quantifies behavioral changes in dementia in nursing home patients and evaluates 12 behavioral domains. For each of the 12 behavioral domains the Frequency (scale:1=occasionally to 4=very frequently) is multiplied by the Severity (scale:1=Mild to 3=Severe) to obtain a domain score (frequency x severity), The NPI-NH Psychosis Subscale consists of the two domains of Delusions and Hallucinations, calculated by adding the Individual domain scores, to yield a possible total score of 0 to 24. Lower scores correspond to less severity. A negative change score from baseline indicates improvement.
